title: Yunikorn k8shim: malicious HTTP/2 peer can cause excessive CPU consumption in the client or server by… (CVE-2026-78669)
description: A vulnerability in the yunikorn-k8shim package allows a malicious HTTP/2 peer to cause excessive CPU consumption on the client or server. This occurs when the attacker opens many streams and sends numerous small SETTINGS frames with SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE values. The issue affects versions prior to 1.9.0-r1 and has a high severity rating.
